name: an-all-read-only-pipeline-over-keels-user-global-state-still-runs
description: The other half of fixture 93, and the bound on what its taint may cost: naming the directory in one segment does NOT ban the pipe. Every segment here is on the read-only allowlist, so reading keel's registry through a pipeline - which is how the doctor, the board and any curious session actually look at it - still runs. This project carries NO ledger on purpose, so a regression that turned the spelled-taint into a blanket ban on pipelines shows up here as a block rather than as silence.
